Mr. V's rules of the game

Like a good baseball team, a good class runs on a few simple rules.

1. Have fun

Science is more fun when you are curious. Ask lots of questions.

2. Play fair

Everyone earns their own V Coins. No sharing passwords.

3. Be a good teammate

Help your friends and cheer for the whole class.

About the website

Viewing as Student
On this page
Getting started

1Choose your device

Everyone

The first time you open the website it asks if you want a tour, then asks which device you are using. This makes the site fit your screen.

  1. The first time you visit, a window asks Want a quick tour? Press Yes, show me the tour to open this tour in a new tab, or No thanks to skip it.
  2. Next comes Which device are you using? The device the site found is already picked for you.
  3. Press Auto choose the right device if you are not sure, or tap Windows, Mac, Chromebook, Linux, iPad, iPhone or Android.
  4. Picking a different device than the one you are really on shows an error. Pick the device you are on, or use Auto choose.
  5. Press Done. Phones and tablets get a smaller, tighter size. You can open Device config at the bottom of the page any time.
  6. The owner can also set the device for any teacher or student account. That account then sees the site in that device size.
Tip: phones show the site much smaller than a computer, so you can see more at once.

2Log in

Students and teachers

Log in so the site remembers your coins, your progress and your friends. You stay logged in on that device until you log out.

  1. Press Login at the top of the page.
  2. Choose Student or Teacher.
  3. Students: pick your period, search for your name, then type your 10 digit password.
  4. Teachers: pick your name, then enter the site password and the classroom confirmation code.
  5. Press Log in.
Keep your password private. Never share it with another student.

3Home

Everyone

The Home page says hello and has quick buttons to start practicing or find your period.

  1. Press Start practicing to jump into science questions.
  2. Press Find my period to see your class schedule.
  3. Use the tabs at the top to move around. Use the arrows to slide the tabs left and right.
  4. Press Take the tour to open this tour. Press the mail button to email Mr. V.
Learn and earn

4Practice and Study

Students

Answer science questions by unit. Right answers earn V Coins.

  1. Pick a Unit and a Level: Easy, Mid or Hard.
  2. Choose a mode: Stage Practice, Custom Quiz, Study and Review or Challenge me as I go.
  3. Read the question and tap your answer.
  4. Bonus questions are worth 5 to 10 coins. Keep a streak going for extra rewards.
  5. Work from your teacher is now in its own Assignments tab.

5Currency

Students

Your V Coins and the class EXP bar, all in one place.

  1. Class EXP is shared by the whole class. Your teacher hands it out, up to 500.
  2. My V Coins are yours. Earn them by practicing and by finishing lessons.
  3. Watch the progress bar for your next goal and milestone rewards.
  4. Your first login gives you a free welcome gift of 100 coins.
  5. Daily tasks give new goals every day, like answering questions or playing a game. Finish them for bonus coins.

6Game Room

Students

Spend V Coins on play time and play games with the class.

  1. Check your coins at the top.
  2. Pick a game, for example Block Dash, Swing Man, Memory Lab or Bubble Pop.
  3. Choose a level: Easy, Mid or Hard. Harder levels are faster.
  4. Choose how much play time to buy with your coins. Passes cost 40, 200 or 400 coins.
  5. Press Play. The clock only runs while you are playing.
  6. Press Pause (or P) to stop the clock. Press End game (or Esc) to finish early.

7Calculating

Everyone

Numbers about how you and your class are doing.

  1. See your time on the website, your V Coins, class XP and questions right.
  2. Scroll down for My last 7 days and how every period compares.

8Mr.V Enterprise

Students

Extra perks for your account, like bonus coins and more ways to make your profile yours.

  1. You start on the Free plan.
  2. Compare Free, Starter Enterprise and Enterprise+ to see the perks.
  3. Press a plan to buy it with V Coins, or ask a friend to gift it to you.

9My Plan

Students

See your plan, how many days are left and send a plan to a friend as a gift.

  1. Open My Plan to see your plan and the days left.
  2. Read the perks your plan gives you.
  3. Pick a friend and send a plan as a gift. They get an envelope in their notifications to open.

10Assignments

Students

Work from your teachers: quizzes that grade themselves and work you hand in.

  1. Open the Assignments tab.
  2. Press an assignment to open it.
  3. Quizzes use multiple choice, true or false and short answers. Press Submit to see your score.
  4. For other work, type your answer or add a picture, then press Turn in.
  5. Late work is marked late. Pay attention to the due date.

11AI Helper

Students

A helper page for science questions. It is getting ready and will turn on soon.

  1. Open AI Helper to see what is coming.
  2. It will help you understand science ideas, not do your work for you.
Class life

12Dates

Everyone

The school calendar from September 2026 to June 2027.

  1. Use the arrows to change month.
  2. Click a date to read about it.
  3. Check Coming up for tests, exams and events.
  4. Fun Friday requests open on Fridays.

13Periods

Everyone

The school day runs 8:16 AM to 3:02 PM. Periods are about 25 to 30 minutes.

  1. The top bar shows where the school day is right now.
  2. Look at each day to see the start and end time of every period.
  3. On Tuesdays there are 10 blocks because of KORT.

14Join Classroom

Students

Connect your account to your period.

  1. Choose your period.
  2. Type the classroom confirmation code from your teacher.
  3. Press Join classroom.

15Friends and chat

Students

Add friends from your class and chat. Teachers can turn making friends on or off for each period.

  1. Find someone at the bottom of the page and send a request.
  2. Accept requests in Friend requests.
  3. Open My friends to chat. You can send pictures and reactions.

16Join Game

Students

Play live games with the class, like a quiz on the big screen.

  1. Your teacher shows a 6 digit game code.
  2. Open Join Game and type the code.
  3. Your profile joins the game. Look at the big screen and answer fast.
Make it yours

17My Profile

Everyone

Make it yours with a school friendly picture, color and badge.

  1. Enter your birthday to unlock the picture and profile settings.
  2. Upload a picture or choose a profile color and badge emoji.
  3. Write a short status.
  4. Press Save profile.

18Settings

Everyone

Turn things on or off so the site feels right for you. These are saved for your account on this device.

  1. Pop-up notifications, speed and big pop-ups.
  2. Sound effects and volume.
  3. Show the tour when you log in, high contrast and an easy read font.
  4. Dark mode is optional. The site starts light.

19Notifications

Everyone

Everything you have been told, newest first.

  1. Press the bell at the top to jump here. A red number shows what is new.
  2. Press Delete on one, or Clear all.
For teachers

20Teacher Tools

Teachers

One window with everything a teacher needs to run the class.

  1. XP and Coins: give class XP and set coin payouts.
  2. Notify: send a small or big pop-up.
  3. Control online, Online and log outs: see who is on and log students out.
  4. Create a game: start a live game with a code.
  5. Suspend or ban and Lock tabs: keep the class on track.
  6. Students, Friends and chat, Dates, Fun Friday, Music, Site color and User info.
  7. Site color now has a color wheel and animated colors.

21Presentations

Teachers make, students watch

Teachers build slide shows with buttons, checklists, pictures and more.

  1. Teachers press New presentation.
  2. Add text, pictures or GIFs, shapes, drawings, sticky notes, buttons, due lists and audio.
  3. Press Save, then Present.
  4. Students open the Presentations tab to see the slide shows.

22Assignments (teachers)

Teachers

Make a quiz that grades itself, or work for students to turn in, then see who finished.

  1. Open Assignments and press New assignment.
  2. Add a title, a description and a due date.
  3. Add multiple choice, true or false or short answer questions. Pick the right answers and the points.
  4. Press Save. Students see it right away.
  5. Open Turned in to see scores. Quizzes are graded for you. You can grade other work by hand.
For the owner

23Owner panel

Owner only

The owner has one panel to run the whole website. Nobody else can open it.

  1. Log in as Owner with the owner password.
  2. The panel has sections: Teachers, Accounts, Locks, Party, Spam, Site and Data.
  3. The login file download only shows up when you are logged in as owner.

24Manage teachers

Owner only

Create or delete teachers and choose which periods they teach.

  1. Press Edit to rename a teacher or change periods.
  2. Mr. V and Mr. R can be renamed but not deleted.
  3. Create a teacher with a name and periods. They log in with the site password and classroom code.

25Accounts and passwords

Owner only

Change a student name, period or password, and set the site password and classroom code.

  1. Pick a student. Press Show password to see it.
  2. Change the name, period or password and press Save changes.
  3. Teachers can see student passwords but cannot change anything.
  4. Set a new site password or classroom code. Leave one empty to keep it.

26Locks

Owner only

Stop spending or logins for a student, a period or everyone.

  1. Lock spending so V Coins cannot be used.
  2. Lock logins to keep students from logging in.
  3. Unlock any time.

27Party

Owner only

Start a party that takes over every screen with music and pictures for a short time.

  1. Choose how long and which music.
  2. Type a message and press Start party.
  3. Parties stop on their own after at most 20 minutes. Students can press Leave or Hide.

28Spam

Owner only

Send a burst of pop-ups to the class. It has safeguards so it cannot get out of hand.

  1. Write the message and choose who gets it.
  2. Press Start. Students can hide it.

29Turn the site off

Owner only

Close the website for everyone while you fix something. You can always log in as owner.

  1. Type a title and a reason, then turn the site off.
  2. Everyone else sees the off screen. Their coins and XP are safe.
  3. Press Log in as owner on the off screen to get back in and turn it on.

30Data and the login file

Owner only

Keep the shared data connected and download the private login file.

  1. The login file is made on your device. It is not a public link.
  2. It can only be downloaded while you are logged in as owner.
  3. Put firebase.txt next to the website to share data between devices.
On the go

31On your phone

Everyone

Everything above works on a phone or tablet. The tabs slide sideways at the top.

  1. Swipe the tab bar to see more pages.
  2. Use Device config to pick iPhone, iPad or Android. Phones show the site smaller.

About Mr. Rowland

Hi there! My name is Jon Rowland and I am a special education teacher and baseball coach at Elwood Middle School! I went to Patchogue-Medford High School and Binghamton University where I graduated with a degree in geological science. I then went on to get my masters in special education from Touro College. I spent four years as a Teaching Assistant in Elwood, and this will be my sixth year as a full time teacher!

Personally, I am an avid Mets, Islanders, and Jets fan. My hobbies include running, golfing, skiing, hiking, and watching TV shows.
